channel.title: Revolution Media Pte - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Revolution Media Pte (revolutionwatch.com)

item.title: Celebrating Heritage and Timeless Elegance
item.description: Vacheron Constantin launches its first Concours d’Élégance Horlogère with Phillips in Association with Bacs &amp; Russo.

item.title: Breitling Forever: Breitling Navitimer B19 Chronograph 43 Perpetual Calendar
item.description: Breitling expands its perpetual calendar chronograph offerings with two stealthy new iterations.

item.title: The Unique Creations of L.Leroy
item.description: L.Leroy perpetuates its storied legacy through creations that elevate bespoke watchmaking into an emotional experience.

item.title: Back to Basics: The Squale SUB-37
item.description: Historic dive-watch maker Squale returns with a compact dive watch built for function and strength.

item.title: Citizen Eco-Drive at 50: Half a Century of Light-Powered Innovation
item.description: Over the last 50 years, Citizen’s Eco-Drive technology has reshaped modern watchmaking, from the world’s first light-powered analog watch in 1976 to today’s highly efficient movements, capable of running for a full year on a single power reserve. Now Citizen celebrates the anniversary with the launch of the new Eco-Drive PHOTON.

item.title: Tudor Turns 100 in 2026: Here's How They Might Celebrate
item.description: With Tudor’s centenary in 2026, it enters the year with more than history on its side: it has a stronger modern identity than ever, and several plausible ways to translate that milestone into the watches we may soon see.

item.title: The Oyster Case Turns 100 in 2026: Here’s How Rolex Might Celebrate
item.description: As 2026 approaches, Rolex predictions are already beginning to surface.

item.title: My Take on the Louis Vuitton Watch Prize for Independent Creatives 2026
item.description: Hazemann & Monnin took top honors, but beyond their standout School Watch, the second edition of the LV Watch Prize revealed something deeper: the sense of unity and camaraderie that continues to bind independent watchmakers across nations and generations.

item.title: Gerald Charles Announces the Masterlink Perpetual Calendar and the Mini Maestro
item.description: Gerald Charles expands its Masterlink lineup with a sophisticated perpetual calendar, and a ladies watch true to the spirit of Gérald Charles Genta’s design

item.title: Fleming Series 1 Mark II
item.description: Following a week living with the new Series 1 Mark II “Redwood”, Revolution’s U.S. editor reflects on how far Fleming has come in the past two years.

item.title: Mathieu Cleguer Makes His Debut with the Inspiration One Souscription
item.description: A time-only watch with a striking layout and an ingenious proprietary self-starting double-wheel escapement – a modern solution to Breguet’s natural escapement.

item.title: Montblanc Expands 0 Oxygen with New Iced Sea, 1858 and Star Legacy Watches
item.description: Montblanc’s latest 2026 novelties are led by the Iced Sea Automatic Date 0 Oxygen, alongside new 1858 and Star Legacy models that reinforce the brand’s diver, explorer and classical watchmaking directions.
